desc:
🏦 It's the year 2001 when you with your team of expert criminals invade the bank in the middle of U.S. Route 50 to pull off the deadliest heist of the decade! Who would've thought some fellow criminals would go after the only bank one The Loneliest Road in America? 💰 Breach the vault, collect the stuff and reach your warehouse safely... there's a lot of police after you... 👮

👍 MASKS CAN NOW BE CUSTOMIZED!! + MORE UPDATES + BUG FIXES!! 👍

(The game is in it's Early stages. Bugs and errors might occur, please report them to the creator. Thank you for cooperating. We read every feedback.)

👍 LIKE and ⭐ FAVORITE the game if you want more updates and you'd like to support us!

💎 Join the group to get notified about more updates in the future!
https://www.roblox.com/communities/6948430/EcoCrashed-Games

This game is inspired by Dead Rails by RiccoMiller ❤️
